relations: Car movement shifts roadside scenery, causing the red-brick building to exit left while a green house enters and persists.
A silver SUV enters the upper right window, travels leftward across the frame, and exits the side.
The mirror reflection shows a dark vehicle with lit headlights following, maintaining a centered position with minor jitter.
The mirror housing, A-pillar, and door panel remain roughly fixed, exhibiting only small handheld-style shifts.
caption: The video captures a view from inside a moving car, framed on the driver-side wing mirror and the adjacent window. Through the glass, roadside scenery shifts across the window, with a red-brick building sliding out of view at the left edge and a green house coming into view there and remaining visible. A silver SUV enters at the upper right of the window and travels leftward across the frame, exiting the side by the later portion of the clip. In the mirror's reflection, a dark vehicle with lit headlights follows, holding a roughly centered position with only minor positional jitter. The bright low-sky glow, distant traffic signals, and low commercial buildings persist within the reflected roadway behind the car. The mirror housing, A-pillar, and door panel remain roughly in screen position, showing small handheld-style shifts rather than a deliberate pan.
